title: Seasonal and anomaly chlorophyll–wind association
query: Using the provided MODIS-Aqua and NOAA blended wind data for 2003–2012 in the South China Sea (104–122°E, 1–25°N), investigate the relationship between regional chlorophyll variability and wind speed.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
